descriptions.current-user_helpjuice-sso-create: Mint a Helpjuice SSO token for the currently authenticated Servosity user so they can be redirected into Helpjuice (the in-app knowledge base) without re-authenticating. No request body. Returns 201 with the signed SSO payload. Endpoint: POST /current-user/helpjuice-sso/
descriptions.current-user_hubspot-sso-create: Mint a HubSpot SSO token for the currently authenticated Servosity user so they can be redirected into HubSpot (the in-app support portal) without re-authenticating. No request body. Returns 201 with the signed SSO payload. Endpoint: POST /current-user/hubspot-sso/
descriptions.postmark-webhook_create: Inbound webhook receiver for Postmark mail events (bounces, deliveries, complaints, inbound parsing). Postmark POSTs the event JSON; Servosity processes it asynchronously. Agents should not call this directly — it is intended for Postmark's outbound delivery. Returns 201 on accepted event. Endpoint: POST /postmark-webhook/
descriptions.sms-mfa-callback_create: Inbound callback receiver for Servosity's SMS-based MFA flow — the SMS provider POSTs delivery and reply status here. Agents should not call this directly; it is intended for the SMS provider's webhook delivery. Returns 201 on accepted event. Endpoint: POST /sms-mfa-callback/
descriptions.sms-fm-mfa-callback_create: Inbound callback receiver for the FleetManager (FMDB) SMS-MFA flow — the SMS provider POSTs delivery and reply status here for FMDB-scoped MFA challenges. Agents should not call this directly. Returns 201 on accepted event. Endpoint: POST /sms-fm-mfa-callback/
descriptions.restore-queue-web-login_list: Look up the active restore-queue session for the bearer of the X-Servosity-Restore-Queue-Web-Login-Token header (one-time login from a customer-facing restore page). Required header: X-Servosity-Restore-Queue-Web-Login-Token. Returns the queue context (company, job, queue position) for the token holder. Endpoint: GET /restore-queue-web-login/
descriptions.restore-queue-web-login_update: Refresh or update the restore-queue session associated with the X-Servosity-Restore-Queue-Web-Login-Token header (e.g. extend TTL, mark the customer as having interacted). Required header: X-Servosity-Restore-Queue-Web-Login-Token. Returns the updated session payload. Endpoint: PUT /restore-queue-web-login/
descriptions.components_list: List the UI component metadata Servosity's web frontend renders — feature flags, layout switches, and UI labels resolved per authenticated user. Used by the web UI on every page load; rarely useful to agents. No parameters. Returns a JSON object of component-name keyed flags and strings. Endpoint: GET /components/
descriptions.reports_usage-list: Aggregate usage report across the authenticated user's accessible reseller scope — storage consumed, license counts, and backup activity totals (the same numbers shown on the Servosity usage dashboard). No parameters. Returns a JSON aggregation; shape is dashboard-driven and not formally schema'd. Endpoint: GET /reports/usage/
descriptions.stats_list: Fleet-wide statistics aggregation — totals and counts the Servosity dashboard reports at the top of the page. No parameters; scope is bounded by the caller's permissions. Returns a JSON object of named counters; shape is dashboard-driven and not formally schema'd. Endpoint: GET /stats/
descriptions.stats_live-list: Live (real-time) statistics snapshot — recent backup activity, in-flight jobs, current online agent count. No parameters; scope is bounded by the caller's permissions. Returns a JSON object of named counters; shape is dashboard-driven. Endpoint: GET /stats/live/
descriptions.stats_user-list: Per-user statistics — counts and totals scoped to the authenticated user's owned accounts (versus the fleet-wide /stats/ aggregation). No parameters. Returns a JSON object of named counters; shape is dashboard-driven. Endpoint: GET /stats/user/
